author: Widogeist
body:
It re-rolls the anguish bonus on your anguished gear. You must have an anguished bonus first in order to use a Ygg Crucible to re-roll it. So if the piece of gear you're using the crucible on doesn't have a bonus, you need to use an Anguished Crucible first to give it a bonus.

Anguished Crucibles can give [these](https://i.imgur.com/B4oNYEJ.jpeg) possible bonuses.

Ygg Crucibles can give [these](https://i.imgur.com/uePgyIG.jpeg) possible bonuses.

Ygg and Anguished Crucible bonuses **do not stack**, they override/replace each other. Each crucible has their own set of possible bonuses, the Ygg Crucible just gives us extra options to choose from depending on your build.
